category: Human Broadcast — 32 kbps MP3 re-encoded (broadcast loss simulation)
notes: Source: human_04_anchor_bulletin.wav (confirmed REAL, correctly classified). Re-encoded to 32 kbps MP3 via FFmpeg then decoded back to PCM WAV to simulate broadcast-quality compression loss. Ground truth remains REAL. Included to test whether compression artefacts trigger false positives.

category: Human-proxy — telephone bandwidth noise (300–3400 Hz, ~8 dB SNR)
notes: Parametric proxy: irregular-pitch voiced source + wideband noise filtered to telephone bandwidth (300–3400 Hz). Mimics a degraded phone-recorded human voice. Ground truth: REAL (human vocal-tract parametric model, not a TTS engine). CAVEAT: this is a synthetic acoustic proxy. Labelled REAL because it models human prosody + noise, not deterministic TTS. Results should be interpreted with caution.

category: Synthetic — formant synthesis (additive harmonics + biquad vocal tract)
notes: Deterministic formant synthesiser: harmonic source with gentle pitch variation + two biquad bandpass filters simulating F1/F2 vocal tract resonances. Ground truth: AI_GENERATED by construction — no human vocal cords involved.

category: Synthetic — flat-pitch buzz TTS (no prosody, word-gap silences)
notes: Flat-pitch (180 Hz) buzz with harmonic additive synthesis, telephone filter, and periodic silence gaps simulating word boundaries. No prosody variation. Ground truth: AI_GENERATED — acoustically the most obviously machine-generated sample.

category: Human Broadcast — 64 kbps MP3 re-encoded (higher quality broadcast)
notes: Source: human_01_reuters_news.wav (known false-positive — model misclassified as AI_GENERATED). Re-encoded to 64 kbps MP3 then decoded to WAV. Tests if moderate compression alleviates or preserves the false-positive behaviour on this known-hard sample. Ground truth: REAL.

category: Human-proxy — Hindi female prosody (irregular pitch, clean SNR ~25 dB)
notes: Parametric proxy: irregular-pitch sinusoidal source (200–260 Hz, Hindi female range) with slight random jitter and low-level noise, wideband filter. Represents the acoustic range of Hindi speech without actual recording. CAVEAT: This is a prosody proxy, not a real recording. Ground truth: REAL (prosody model). Interpret with caution.

category: Synthetic — formant synthesis female pitch (200 Hz fundamental)
notes: Same formant synthesiser as EXT_03 but with female pitch (200 Hz fundamental). Tests whether the detector generalises across pitch ranges for synthetic speech. Ground truth: AI_GENERATED by construction.

category: Edge Case — sub-0.2 s sample (detector UNCERTAIN guard)
notes: 0.15-second pure tone. Duration < 0.2 s threshold triggers the detector's UNCERTAIN guard. Expected prediction: UNCERTAIN (available=True, error set). Ground truth is 'UNCERTAIN' here meaning 'not classifiable' — this tests the failsafe behaviour, not detection accuracy.
